title: Light Fluffy Vietnamese Chicken Pho Ga
description: A delicate and refreshing Vietnamese chicken noodle soup featuring a soured cream and chive dip, made with low sodium ingredients and a rich deglaze fond.
instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and set aside.
Char the onion and ginger over an open flame until slightly blackened.
In a large pot, combine the charred onion and ginger, star anise, and 4 cups of low sodium chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until cooked through.
Cook the pho noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Strain the broth through a fine mesh sieve into a clean pot, discarding the solids.
Add the fish sauce to the broth and stir to combine.
Serve the soup over the cooked noodles, garnished with a dollop of soured cream and a sprinkle of chopped chives.
Deglaze the pot with a little water to release the fond and add it to the soup for added richness.
